name: 30 Pack - 30x1g Pre-roll - Black Amber
description:
Thirty joints, one box. The 30 Pack Black Amber gives you thirty full-gram pre-rolls — 30 grams total — rolled with quality flower and ready to smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no running out. Just grab one and go.

Black Amber brings a rich, deep profile: dark berry and stone fruit sweetness up front, layered with warm earthy notes, a touch of spice, and a smooth, resinous finish. It's a bold, full-bodied flavor made for easygoing sessions and laid-back evenings.

Why you'll love it:

30 × 1G pre-rolls — 30 grams total, serious value in one box
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Black Amber flavor — dark berry and stone fruit with warm earth and spice
Relaxed, easygoing effects — mellow and smooth, ideal for winding down

Big value, dependable quality, and everyday convenience in every box. The 30 Pack Black Amber is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
